text: According to the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center, Nika Shakarami took part in street protests in Tehran on 20 September 2022 and disappeared afterward. Her mother said Nika opposed compulsory hijab and the morality patrol, and joined demonstrations over the demands of women and young people. Accounts of her final hours differ; her family disputed the official explanation of her death.

The Abdorrahman Boroumand Center records that Nika Shakarami moved to Tehran in 2021 and worked at a cafe near Enghelab Square. She had studied painting at Vahdat Vocational School in Fardis, Karaj. During her final year she lived with her aunt Atash, a painter who encouraged her art.

The Abdorrahman Boroumand Center reports that Mani Safarpour was killed during protests in Tehran's Salsabil neighborhood on the evening of 8 January 2026. Its account does not establish the date he first joined protests. Mani was born on 3 December 2007, supported Persepolis, and was buried in Lafmejan village near Lahijan in Gilan.

sources.title: Abdorrahman Boroumand Center · Mani Safarpur Chafali

text: The Abdorrahman Boroumand Center reports that Sarina Esmailzadeh joined demonstrations in Mehrshahr, Karaj, on 23 September 2022 despite her brother's objections. It reports that security forces beat her with batons and that she died from head injuries. Its record also documents the authorities' conflicting account.

According to the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center, Neda Aqa Soltan attended a demonstration with her music instructor on 20 June 2009. She had joined demonstrations challenging the announced presidential election results. She was shot in Tehran's Kargar neighborhood that evening.

sources.title: Abdorrahman Boroumand Center · Neda Aqa Soltan

text: The Abdorrahman Boroumand Center describes Kian Pirfalak traveling home in a car with his parents and younger brother in Izeh on 16 November 2022. He was killed when the car came under fire. This account describes a family returning home during unrest, not Kian going out to join a protest. The family blamed security forces, contrary to the official account.

According to the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center, Jina Mahsa Amini was visiting Tehran with her family when morality police arrested her on 13 September 2022 near Shahid Haqqani metro station. She was on her way to see relatives, rather than attending a protest. She died on 16 September 2022 after three days in a coma; protests followed her death.

Iran International reports that Hamid Mahdavi, a firefighter from Mashhad, was killed on 8 January 2026. It describes witness and social-media accounts of him carrying wounded protesters to safety during his final hours. The article says the identity of the man in the widely shared rescue video has not been established with certainty. It does not establish when Hamid first attended a protest.

sources.title: Iran International · How images came to carry Iran's protest dead

text: Factnameh traces the photograph of Khodanoor Lajei tied to a pole to an earlier detention in July 2022. The image shows him in Baloch clothing with water placed outside his reach. It is not a photograph of his final moments. Factnameh presents relatives' account that he was wounded the day after Zahedan's Bloody Friday and died in hospital on 2 October 2022, while examining a conflicting official account.

ITV reports that Hadis Najafi regularly posted on TikTok and Instagram. In a video sent to a friend on the night she was killed, she hoped her future self would be happy she had joined the protest. ITV also explains that a viral clip of a woman tying back her hair was misidentified as Hadis; it did not show her final moments.
